body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> HANBIT Electronics introduced ''Pepper PAD 3'' handheld entertainment computer during KES 2006. The Korean company had teamed with Pepper Computing Company and was able to launch this model last October in USA market initially andnow it is introducing the model in Korea market through this show. With embedded Linux OS, it supports web browsing, instant messaging, video playback, email, internet radio, game and etc. It features 7-inch LCD display, 20GB HDD, WiFi and Bluetooth connectivity. HANBIT Electronics said that this is a sort of second-pc that users could use at home, and unlike existing UMPC, this model put more emphasis on entertainment features over business-related features.
